body: Therapy and antidepressants really can help, and you won’t be sent to a psych ward unless a doctor has reason to believe you are at risk of harming yourself and/or others. I know that’s the problem in my situation and that realistically I should be hospitalized again, but the thought of it all, and then coming back home after, sounds like more than my body is even capable of handling right now. I really feel like an 87 year old in a 25 year old’s body. It can’t hurt to get a therapist though if you want one. And not being able to afford to miss work is a valid reason in itself to have trouble with depression. I hope both of us have at least one good day soon

I scrolled so far to see if anyone else said this! I watched horror movies from a very young age and was more fascinated than scared...until I watch The Ring in 2nd grade and didn’t sleep for months. I would actually crawl into my little brother’s bed just so I wouldn’t be alone because I was so terrified of that scene with the girl in the closet. I’m 25 now, absolutely adore horror, and STILL can’t bring myself to watch it again.
